get.description:
Nominal and real return of free-market USD, gold, coin and the one-year treasury yield
over the last ``months`` months, against inflation released by the as-of day (docs/07).

Latest NAV per fund (fipiran) and, for listed units, the bubble against the close of
the same day (docs/06).

Adjusted daily candles (never raw prices), the latest stored features and this symbol's
published signals.

Hold for the AGM or sell before it (docs/05). DPS and timing come from the caller; the
price, the risk-free rate (default for r_m and r_alt) and the costs come from the database,
and every input says where it came from.

The latest stored intraday snapshot and 5-level order book. ``available=false`` is a normal
state (market closed, or the live poller is not running).

Calibration of the latest model: out-of-sample (walk-forward backtest) and live (the
signals actually published and since resolved).

Live accuracy of published signals by signal date, and the state of the Brier kill
switch (docs/10 section 9) and defensive mode (section 10).

The day's ranked list, or an explicit "no recommendation" (the normal outcome whenever
nothing passes the thresholds). ``date`` defaults to the latest day with a recorded run.

Every symbol that traded on the latest stored day, with its market data, a few features
and the latest model output for ``timeframe``. The model output is a diagnostic: only rows
on /recommendations are published recommendations.

Published signals, newest first, each with its realised outcome once the label window
has closed. ``realized_return`` is the gross barrier return, before costs.

Latest ranking of the liquid basket written by ``python -m tmon.tools.v2_ranking``,
with the evidence per horizon and the gate verdicts. Not a recommendation unless
``recommendation_allowed`` is true.
